[!assets] skip 'requires embedded web assets'

exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-18T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix web-

# Invalid store configuration does not prevent the selected board's browser
# shell and bootstrap catalog from serving.
exec sh -c 'printf "version: [\n" > .cardamom/config.yaml'
exec sh probe-web.sh
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/probe.txt
cmpjson catalog.json $WORK/golden/catalog.json

-- probe-web.sh --
#!/bin/sh
set -eu

board_id=board_00000000000000000000
card web --bind 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --no-browser >web.out 2>web.err &
pid=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT

i=0
url=
while [ "$i" -lt 100 ]; do
  url=$(sed -n 's/^web application available at //p' web.out | head -n 1)
  [ -n "$url" ] && break
  if ! kill -0 "$pid" 2>/dev/null; then
    cat web.err >&2
    wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    exit 1
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.02
done
[ -n "$url" ]

curl --fail --silent "$url/" >shell.body
grep '<div id="app"></div>' shell.body >/dev/null

curl --fail --silent --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
  --data '{}' \
  "$url/cardamom.private.v1.ProjectService/GetBootstrap" >bootstrap.json

jq '{
  projects: (.projects // []),
  boards: (.boards // []),
  serverDefaultBoardId: (.serverDefaultBoardId // null)
}' bootstrap.json >catalog.json

configuration_status=$(curl --silent --output configuration.body \
  --write-out '%{http_code}' \
  --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
  --data "{\"boardId\":\"$board_id\"}" \
  "$url/cardamom.private.v1.ConfigurationService/GetConfiguration")
[ "$configuration_status" = 500 ]
jq -e '.code == "internal"' configuration.body >/dev/null

mutation_status=$(curl --silent --output mutation.body \
  --write-out '%{http_code}' \
  --request POST \
  --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --header 'Connect-Protocol-Version: 1' \
  --data "{\"boardId\":\"$board_id\",\"title\":\"Unavailable\",\"type\":\"ISSUE_TYPE_TASK\",\"priority\":2,\"context\":{\"actor\":\"script\"}}" \
  "$url/cardamom.private.v1.PlanningService/CreateIssue")
[ "$mutation_status" = 500 ]
jq -e '.code == "internal"' mutation.body >/dev/null

kill -TERM "$pid"
wait "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
trap - EXIT
echo 'invalid configuration web probe passed'

-- golden/catalog.json --
{"projects":[{"id":"project_00000000000000000000","name":"script-web_invalid_configuration"}],"boards":[{"id":"board_00000000000000000000","projectId":"project_00000000000000000000","name":"script-web_invalid_configuration"}],"serverDefaultBoardId":"board_00000000000000000000"}
-- golden/probe.txt --
invalid configuration web probe passed
